message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Run tests
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - develop
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - develop
  # Allows to run this workflow manually from the Actions tab
  workflow_dispatch:
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: "Checkout branch ${{ github.head_ref }}"
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: "Setup node"
        uses: actions/setup-node@v3
        with:
          node-version: 16
          cache: npm
      - name: "Cache Rust dependencies"
        uses: actions/cache@v3
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-
      - name: "Install the rust compiler"
        run: |
          curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs | sh -s -- -y
          source "$HOME/.cargo/env"
      - name: "Install wasm-pack"
        run: |
          curl https://rustwasm.github.io/wasm-pack/installer/init.sh -sSf | sh -s -- -y
      - name: "Run cargo clippy"
        run: cd src/core && cargo clippy --all-targets --features=webgl2 -- -D warnings
      - name: Format check
        run: cd src/core && cargo fmt --all -- --check
      - name: "Install dependencies"
        run: |
          npm install
      - name: "Build Aladin Lite"
        run: |
          npm run build:dbg
      - name: "Run the rust tests"
        run: |
          npm run test:build",
  "rationale": "The workflow fetches dependencies (npm packages, Rust crates via cargo registry, and git dependencies) on every run with no caching. P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (Cache dependency downloads) is supported by observational evidence showing modest CI savings, and its preconditions are met: repeated dependency fetching is measurable (npm install, rustup, wasm-pack, cargo build run every job), and cache inputs include lockfiles/environment (package.json and Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock exist). The change adds npm caching via setup-node's cache option and a scoped actions/cache step for the Rust cargo registry and git dependency store, keyed on Cargo.lock. All original build, lint, format, and test steps are preserved unchanged; no permissions are weakened, no secrets or deployment operations are added, and no new network access is introduced beyond the existing downloads.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
